messages:
jon: quick poll — weird nightcap edition. what's one song/movie/book you only turn to at 2am? drop a single pick and i'll tally 👍

maya: Song — Beach House ‘Space Song’. immediate soft-core insomnia cure. :purple_heart:

alex: Movie — Primer. rewatching that at 3am feels like a puzzle you can almost solve. :thinking_face:

priya: Book — The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle. murakami at night is a whole mood. :zzz:

sam: Song — Ratatat ‘Loud Pipes’. weirdly calming chaos. also puts me in coding-til-dawn mode. :headphones:

riley: Movie — The Fall (Tarsem). gorgeous visuals, like falling into a painting. :art:

jon: ok listing options for a silly tally: 1) Space Song (maya) 2) Primer (alex) 3) Wind-Up Bird Chronicle (priya) 4) Loud Pipes (sam) 5) The Fall (riley)

maya: also low-key guilty convos: i sometimes read weird tumblr microfiction before sleep. tiny brain snacks. :cup_with_straw:

alex: dropping a tiny playlist link if anyone wants a 20min late-night loop — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2fakeIDnotreal 

priya: vote: 3 (book)

sam: vote: 4

riley: vote: 5

jon: tally so far: Space Song 1, Primer 1, Wind-Up Bird Chronicle 2, Loud Pipes 1, The Fall 1

maya: making a shameless push for Space Song, casting another vote :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

jon: final tally: Space Song 2, Primer 1, Wind-Up Bird Chronicle 2, Loud Pipes 1, The Fall 1 — tie for first between Space Song and Wind-Up Bird. consensus: late-night winners are mellow surrealism. :tada:

alex: love this. please do again next week but make it 90s one-hit wonders at midnight.

priya: agreed. next theme: two-sentence horror stories at 1:30am? :jack_o_lantern:

jon: noted. new recurring thread: nocturne recs. i'll start it next friday. :calendar:
